correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 11–51 are correct in their two separate regimes. Competing reset/jump clocks make event times Exp(r+2d) independently of marks. Repeated trials select the single-trial success law. A route of length L+2 has exactly one extra opposite pair; premature hits are precisely the K minimal routes followed by either two-hop return in the marked coordinate. The subtraction is 2K even when m_j=0; c_j≥L. Parity plus a geometric bound controls both the tail and its first moment at fixed d,m. The duration conditional on N=n is exactly Gamma(n,1) after scaling; the leading signed mixture correction has only Gamma(L+2) minus Gamma(L), whose densities cross at sqrt(L(L+1)). In high dimension the Bessel integral is the unrestricted walk series, and first-hit convolution gives the quotient of Green functions. The remainder bounds follow by factoring I0^p−1−px² (Taylor in I0−1, using 0≤I0−1≤x²e^{2x}, I0≤e^{2x}) and expanding the I2 factor separately; e^{-(1−2c)s} dominates the polynomial remainders uniformly at q=c/d, c=(α+2)^{-1}<1/2. Integration gives the q⁴ terms 12d−8 and 2d in the numerator and denominator, hence 10d−8 in the first-hit series. To justify the hop moment without differentiating big-O, use positivity: choose fixed λ>1 with λc<1/2 and bound n q^n≤C_λ(λq)^n, applying the same tail bound at λq. The resulting mixture and expectation errors are O_α(d^{-2}). At α=2, c=1/4 yields 5/8 and 5/4 as stated. No optimum is inferred. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/review-evidence/reproduce.py 5 (log /workspace/review-evidence/5.txt); 120 signed starting sites, independent interleaving/renewal counts in seven dimensions through order ten, and numerical quadrature of five TV constants. These are bounded corroboration, not uniform-tail certificates. The supplied verifier was inspected, not run.

value.rationale: The two-hop cutoff is fixed by lattice parity, not chosen to maximize an effect, and the high-dimensional scaling is motivated by a published measurement of exactly this successful segment. The directional split identifies the transverse source of the first localization error, and the explicit TV coefficient measures the accuracy of a usable leading Gamma approximation. These are useful refinements of the known scalar mechanism, not a claim of a general renewal theorem or of optimal resetting.
